styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting in the style of a sunset landscape: sky of layered flat gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold, orange and red glowing between them, figures and trees as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.CHILSEONG: a lean male rope acrobat in his twenties, hair tied back with a red headband, white jeogori and baji with a red sash, barefoot
characters.JANG: a thin storehouse keeper in his sixties, short white beard, faded brown jeogori, gray topknot, never bald
characters.AJEON: a county clerk in his forties with a thin mustache, a dark navy official coat and a small black horsehair hat
characters.JWASU: a rich old landowner in his fifties with a long gray beard, a wide black gat hat and a pale silk overcoat
characters.WONNIM: the county magistrate, a dignified man with a short beard in a crimson official robe and black hat

scenes.S01: No people anywhere in the picture: a single thin rope stretched tight between two tall wooden posts above an empty village market square at dawn, a long balancing pole leaning against one post, closed stalls around. Nobody, no hands, no feet. Plain sky, nothing written.
scenes.S02: CHILSEONG walking a tight rope, both bare feet planted directly on the rope which touches the soles of his feet, both hands gripping a long pole held level at waist height. Below him WONNIM in a crimson robe looks up among a crowd. Daylight market. He is not floating.
scenes.S05: CHILSEONG walking on a single thin rope high between two tall wooden posts, holding a long balancing pole, above a market square where a crowd of villagers look up and clap. Daylight, mountains behind.
scenes.S06: A traveling troupe of Joseon performers raising two tall wooden posts in a market square and tying a long rope between them, a drum and a barrel drum on the ground, four men working together. Daylight.
scenes.S07: Only one person in the picture: CHILSEONG sitting alone on the ground in the back yard of a tiled-roof house at night, eating from a wooden bowl, a stone wall beside him, lantern light from the far side. No other people.
scenes.S08: A bird eye view from high above a Joseon village seen from a rope: tiled roofs, walled courtyards with their back yards visible inside, narrow alleys, a bamboo grove, tiny people far below. Daylight, no big figures in front.
scenes.S09: [SIL] Sunset over a village market, a lone man standing on a high rope between two posts as a black silhouette holding a long pole, layered gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold behind him.
scenes.S10: Exactly two people and nobody else: JANG holding out a bowl of hot soup with both hands, and CHILSEONG receiving it with a bowed head, in front of a wooden storehouse door. Daylight, steam rising.
scenes.S11: Only one person in the picture: JANG the old storehouse keeper kneeling inside a dim wooden storehouse, tying a straw rice sack with rope, rows of stacked rice sacks behind him. Warm light from the open door.
scenes.S12: A moonlit night scene: two ox carts loaded high with straw sacks covered by woven mats, moving down a narrow alley between stone walls, two men walking beside them with their heads low. Deep blue night, no faces visible.
scenes.S13: Only one person in the picture: CHILSEONG standing on a high tightrope at night above an empty market square, holding a long wooden balancing pole horizontally with both hands, looking down to one side with a puzzled face. Plain dark blue night sky with a moon, absolutely no letters, no calligraphy, no signboards anywhere. A few small lanterns far below.
scenes.S14: A wooden storehouse on fire at dawn, orange flames and thick smoke rising from the roof, village men running toward it carrying water buckets, seen from a distance. No large faces in front.
scenes.S15: Exactly three people in a county office courtyard: JANG the old keeper on his knees with his head bowed, two servants in dark clothes gripping his arms, AJEON the county clerk standing and pointing at him with a cold face. Daylight, tiled wall behind.
scenes.S16: [WEB] Scene in a county office courtyard, two clear roles: 1. LEFT, on his knees with his hands together, speaking earnestly: CHILSEONG the young acrobat in white clothes with a red headband. 2. RIGHT, standing over him raising a wooden rod with an angry face: AJEON the county clerk in a dark navy coat. Servants watch from the side. Daylight.
scenes.S17: [SIL] Sunset on an empty market street, a lone young man sitting on the ground with his head down as a black silhouette, a long pole fallen beside him, gray and silver clouds with a gold band.
scenes.S19: Exactly two people: CHILSEONG crouching outside a wooden prison lattice window with both hands on the bars, and JANG the old keeper sitting inside in the dark with his head down. Night, one lantern on the wall.
scenes.S20: Two tall wooden posts in an empty market square at night with one rope stretched tight between them, both ends knotted to the post tops. CHILSEONG sits cross-legged on the ground below, looking up at the rope with a thoughtful face. Nothing in his hands. Moonlight.
scenes.S21: Four men of a traveling troupe gathered around a drum in a courtyard at night, one of them CHILSEONG speaking with his hand raised, the others listening closely, lantern light on their faces.
scenes.S22: A traveling troupe beating a drum and a barrel drum in a busy market square, villagers gathering around them from every direction, stalls and flags behind. Bright daylight, no single large face.
scenes.S23: A magistrate procession stopped at the edge of a crowded market street: WONNIM in a crimson official robe standing in front of a palanquin with two attendants, looking ahead with a puzzled face, a crowd filling the street beyond.
scenes.S24: CHILSEONG standing on a high rope between two posts holding a long pole, a huge crowd of villagers below looking up, and WONNIM in a crimson robe standing at the front of the crowd. Bright daylight, market flags around.
scenes.S25: CHILSEONG up on the high tightrope with both bare feet on the rope between two tall posts, holding a long balancing pole horizontally in one hand and stretching the other arm forward in a funny mime, a crowd of villagers far below on the ground looking up and laughing. He is high in the air on the rope, not standing on the ground. Daylight market square.
scenes.S27: Exactly two men standing side by side at the front of a crowd: LEFT, AJEON with his face stiff and pale; RIGHT, JWASU turning his face away. Villagers behind them still looking up. Daylight market square.
scenes.S28: Two tall posts, one at the left edge, one at the right edge, a rope stretched tight between their tops and knotted at both ends. CHILSEONG stands barefoot in the middle of the rope, right arm out pointing, left arm out, no pole. Below, WONNIM and a crowd look up.
scenes.S29: A crowd of villagers rushing together toward the tall gate of a large tiled-roof house, dust rising from their feet, the gate swinging open. Daylight, seen from a distance, no large faces.
scenes.S30: The back yard of a noble house beside a bamboo grove: exactly three village men digging a fresh mound of earth with hoes, straw rice sacks half uncovered in the dirt. Behind them a crowd of villagers stare with open mouths. At the right WONNIM watches. Daylight, plain wall, nothing written.
scenes.S31: Exactly two men bound with ropes at their arms in a courtyard, AJEON the clerk with his head down and JWASU the old landowner without his hat, led away by two constables in dark clothes. Villagers watching from the side. Daylight.
scenes.S32: Exactly two people at an open wooden prison gate: CHILSEONG carrying JANG on his back piggyback, the old man arms over his shoulders, walking out slowly. Nothing in his hands, no pole. Daylight, a few villagers far behind.
scenes.S34: Exactly two people in a county office courtyard: WONNIM standing with a kind face, and CHILSEONG standing before him with a long pole in one hand, head slightly bowed. Daylight, tiled wall behind.
scenes.S35: Only one person in the picture: CHILSEONG standing in an empty market square pointing at two spots on the ground with a calm face. Daylight, closed stalls around.
scenes.S36: WONNIM in a crimson official robe standing on a veranda calling out with one hand raised, CHILSEONG standing in the courtyard below looking up at him, a crowd of villagers filling the courtyard behind. Daylight.
scenes.S37: Two tall wooden posts firmly planted in a village market square with a rope stretched between them, a group of village children sitting on the ground below looking up. Daylight, stalls behind.
scenes.S38: A short rope tied tight between two low wooden stakes at knee height in a village yard, both ends knotted to the stakes. CHILSEONG stands beside it holding the hand of a small child balancing on the rope. Three other children wait in line. Nothing hangs from anyone hand. Daylight.
scenes.S39: [SIL] Full moon over a village market at night: two tall posts with one rope stretched tight between them, a man standing in the middle of the rope as a black silhouette with both arms out. Layered silver clouds and a band of gold light behind.
